title: 2.6 Computer Ports and Cables
description: Common ports, connectors and cable types

questions.question: What is the main purpose of computer ports and cables?
options: To permanently store the operating system
To connect devices and peripherals and facilitate data transfer, power supply and communication
To increase the amount of RAM in a computer
To cool the internal components of a computer
questions.correctAnswer: To connect devices and peripherals and facilitate data transfer, power supply and communication

questions.question: Which port is widely used for connecting devices such as keyboards, mice, printers and external hard drives?
Which USB versions are mentioned as offering different data transfer speeds and power delivery capabilities?
options: USB Mini, USB Micro, USB Nano, and USB Pico

questions.question: What does HDMI stand for?
HDMI ports are primarily used to connect computers to which type of device?
options: External displays such as monitors, TVs and projectors
questions.correctAnswer: External displays such as monitors, TVs and projectors

questions.question: Which signals does an HDMI port transmit to allow seamless multimedia playback?
Which video interface supports high-resolution video and audio and can also carry data signals?
Ethernet ports are also known as which type of ports?
What is the main use of an Ethernet port?
options: Wired network connections to LANs and the internet
Connecting the computer to a power source
questions.correctAnswer: Wired network connections to LANs and the internet

questions.question: Audio ports are commonly used to connect which devices?
Audio ports on computers are typically which type of jack?
Which older analog video port is less common now but is still found on some older monitors and projectors?
What does VGA stand for?
What does DVI stand for?
DVI ports can support which signals?
Thunderbolt ports are high-speed ports that can transmit which signals?
Thunderbolt ports are often found on which type of computers?
A power port is used to do what?
options: Connect the computer to a wired network
Connect the computer to a power source
questions.correctAnswer: Connect the computer to a power source

questions.question: True or False: Ethernet cables such as Cat5e and Cat6 are examples of common cable types.
